name: Lift ram barrel with gland

name: Lift casing, welded steel, in the floor

name: Lock bar bracket

name: Lock bar bracket

function: Hangs a lock bar from the saddle's end.

name: Lift recess pan, galvanised steel

name: Ram top flange

name: Ram position sensor, draw wire, 2 m, absolute

name: Ram wiper and rod seal, PU

name: Socket head cap screw M12 x 50

function: Fastens the slew gearbox to the trolley plate.

function: Fastens the foot plate up to the Z-beam's walls.

name: Head drive box, steel, IP54
function: Holds the 5 nutrunner drives, the DC supply for the head's and the Z drive's servo motors, and the head's safety and EtherCAT modules. It turns with the slew, so only 3 lines cross the slip ring: the supply, EtherCAT and the fibre.

name: Tilt actuator hanger, welded steel
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Hangs under the Z-beam's foot and clamps the tilt actuator's front drum.

name: TLT rear cover
function: Closes the rear of the actuator. The O-ring seals it.

name: TLT actuator housing
material: Aluminium A356-T6 casting, charcoal powder coat
function: Holds the gear ring, the motor and both shaft bearings in line. Fins carry the motor heat out.

name: TLT output flange
function: Carries the next link. It turns on the bearing inner ring.

name: TLT stator retaining ring
function: Pressed into the bore behind the stator. It holds the stator against its shoulder.

name: TLT bearing clamp ring
function: Clamps the bearing outer ring to the housing. The output seal sits in its bore.

name: Head yoke, welded steel
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Hangs the head from the tilt actuator's output flange. The actuator's cross-roller bearing carries it.

name: Spring-applied holding brake 124
function: Springs hold the joint when power is off. The coil releases it. A power cut cannot drop the arm.

name: Frameless torque motor 148x52: rotor
function: Steel hub with the permanent magnets. It turns the hollow motor shaft.

name: Frameless torque motor 148x52: stator core
function: Laminated core with the 3-phase coils. It is bonded into the housing and makes the rotating field.

name: Frameless torque motor 148x52: winding end turns
function: Copper coil ends of the stator winding, with a thermistor for over-temperature stop.

name: Strain-wave gear size 40: circular spline
function: Rigid ring gear with internal teeth. It is bolted to the housing and does not turn.

name: Strain-wave gear size 40: flexspline
function: Thin steel cup with 2 fewer teeth than the ring. It flexes into an ellipse and turns the output.

name: Strain-wave gear size 40: wave generator
function: Elliptical cam on a thin ball bearing. The motor turns it. Each turn moves the output 2 teeth.

name: TLT flexspline clamp ring
function: Spreads the screw load over the thin flexspline diaphragm.

name: TLT hollow motor shaft
function: Carries the wave generator, the rotor, the brake disc and the encoder discs. Cables pass through its bore.

name: Deep groove ball bearing 6814-2RS
function: Supports the motor shaft.

name: Cross-roller bearing 120 x 174 x 24
function: Carries the joint output. It takes the radial, axial and tilt loads in one bearing.

name: Motor encoder, 23-bit absolute (rotor position)
function: Reads the motor shaft angle for the drive. The drive uses it to commutate and run the speed loop.

name: Multi-turn encoder, 16-bit turn count, battery-free
function: Counts the motor turns, with no battery. With the motor encoder it gives the joint angle after the gear at power-up, so the arm needs no homing move.

name: Integrated servo drive board 148
function: Runs the motor: field-oriented current control, safe torque off (STO) and an EtherCAT link.

name: Cable gland M20 x 1.5, IP68
function: Seals the motor power, the safety signal and the EtherCAT cable into the actuator.

name: O-ring 152 x 2
function: Seals the rear cover to the housing.

name: O-ring 164 x 2.5
function: Seals the bearing outer ring to the housing face.

name: Radial shaft seal 149.7 x 162 x 6
function: Seals the turning output flange against the clamp ring (IP65).

name: Retaining ring, shaft 70
function: Holds the bearing in its seat.

name: Socket head cap screw M3 x 16
function: Fastens the encoder read head to the brake end plate.

name: Socket head cap screw M3 x 25
function: Fastens the encoder read head to the brake end plate.

function: Carries the spindle cluster on its bearings, the cover cups, the grip carriage's rails and the cameras.

name: Head cable loop, 8 cables in a spiral sleeve, 40 mm

name: Socket head cap screw M5 x 12

name: Socket head cap screw M5 x 16
function: Fastens the foot junction box to the Z-beam.

name: Cluster bearing, thin section, 290 x 330 x 20

function: Carries the cluster pinion from the motor's shaft.

name: Spur pinion m2 z20

name: Scroll gearmotor, 24 V, with encoder
function: Turns the scroll ring to set the pitch circle.

name: Socket magnet ring
function: Holds the nut in the socket.

name: Cover cup rod, stainless, hollow

name: Suction cup, 50 mm bellows, oil resistant
function: Holds an aero cover by its face.

name: Clamp post, welded aluminium box
function: Hangs from its block and carries its roller. Its ball nut is inside it.

function: Carries the portal's supply, its EtherCAT and its fibre from the pit up into the floor chain's trough.

name: Conduit, the bay's feed, building tray to the cabinet, 50 mm
function: Carries the bay's 480 V feed down the north wall from the building's tray to the cabinet's top.

name: Conduit to the east racks' cable channel, 50 mm
function: Carries the east racks' sensor bus under the floor to the pit.

name: Conduit to the west racks' cable channel, 50 mm
function: Carries the west racks' sensor bus from their channel to the pit.

name: Conduit, floor chain to the portal cabinet, 50 mm
function: Carries the floor chain's lines up the west end truck and the leg to the portal cabinet.

name: Conduit, beam to the east travel motor, 32 mm
function: Carries the east travel motor's, the east emergency stop's and the east cover sensor's cables down the east leg.

name: Conduit, portal cabinet to the west travel motor, 32 mm
function: Carries the west travel motor's cable down to its end truck.

name: Conduit, the site network, building tray to the cabinet, 25 mm
function: Carries the site network's fibre down the north wall to the cabinet's top.

name: Conduit to the front post's reel pocket, 50 mm
function: Carries the front post's reel supply and its casing cable from the pit.

name: Conduit to the rear post's reel pocket, 50 mm
function: Carries the rear post's reel supply and its casing cable round the rear casing.

name: Conduit to the south-west safety scanner, 32 mm
function: Carries the south-west scanner's cable to the pit.

name: Conduit to the north-east safety scanner, 32 mm
function: Carries the north-east scanner's cable to the pit.

name: Cable sleeve, reel pocket to casing, steel tube 28 x 3
function: Brings the casing cable from the reel pocket into the casing, to the 2 pawls and the ram's position sensor.

name: Portal drive cabinet, steel, IP54, 600 x 1100 x 300
function: Rides on the west leg. It holds the 2 travel drives and each robot's trolley and slew drives, the feeds to the 2 robots, the portal's safety I/O and its network switch.

name: Lift pump motor, 5 hp (3.7 kW), 480 V, with its bell housing
function: Drives the lift's gear pump in the tank: 139 L/min at the rated load's 7 bar lifts both rams 1.85 m in 50 s.

name: Lift barrel oil port boss, G 3/4
function: Takes the oil pipe at the barrel's top.

name: Hydraulic pipe to the front ram, 35 x 2.5 steel
function: Carries the oil from its valve to its ram's barrel, under the slab in a sand bed, wrapped.

name: Hydraulic pipe to the rear ram, 35 x 2.5 steel
function: Carries the oil from its valve to its ram's barrel, under the slab in a sand bed, wrapped.

name: Lift power unit tank, 150 L, with its lid
function: Holds the oil for both rams (116 L) and a reserve.

name: Lift valve block, 2 circuits, with pressure sensors
function: Feeds and lowers each ram on its own: a proportional flow valve, a check valve and a lowering valve each, a pressure sensor on each line and a relief valve.

name: Emergency stop post with its box, steel
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Stands beside the south door, where a person comes into the bay.

name: Safety scanner pedestal, steel
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Holds a safety scanner 0.25 m over the floor, out of the cars' and the portal's way. Its cable comes up through its base plate.

name: Safety laser scanner, 275 degrees, PL d, IP65
function: Watches the bay's floor. If a person is in the bay while the machine runs, it stops the machine. The lift lowers only with the floor clear.

name: Status beacon, 4 colours, IP65
function: Green: home, the car may move. Amber: the lift or the portal moves. Red: stopped. Blue: a person is needed.

name: Emergency stop button, red mushroom, 2 NC contacts
function: Stops every motion in the bay and holds it stopped until it is reset at the cabinet.

name: Emergency stop button on the leg, red mushroom, 2 NC contacts
function: Stops every motion in the bay.

name: Emergency stop box on the leg, steel
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Holds an emergency stop on the leg's inner face, in reach of a person at the racks.

name: Pad base
function: Carries the load cell in the cup.

name: Pad cup, welded to the slide
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Holds the pad. Its rim is flush with the floor when the lift is down.

name: Pad rubber block
function: Bears on the car's lift point without marking it.

name: Pad camera with infrared light, IP67
function: Looks up past the pad at the lift point: it checks the pad is centred under it before the car leaves the floor.

name: Pad load cell, 30 kN
function: Reads the pad's share of the car. The lift stops if the 4 shares do not agree with the car's weight.

name: Reel cable, hybrid 48 V and Ethernet, 12 mm
function: Paid out by the spring reel as the ram rises, it feeds the saddle's junction box.

name: Reel cable, hybrid 48 V and Ethernet, 12 mm
function: Paid out by the spring reel as the ram rises, it feeds the saddle's junction box.

name: Reel cable guide, with its roller
function: Turns the reel's cable up under the saddle's junction box, so it pays out straight up as the ram rises.

name: Spring cable reel, 2.5 m
function: Pays the saddle's cable up as the ram rises and winds it back as it lowers.

name: Saddle junction box, IP67
function: Joins the reel's cable to the 2 arms' cables: power and EtherCAT to the pads and the swing drives.
